browser_proof_reference.interpretation: Artifact-reported evidence, not a fresh execution. 68 boundary identities do not mean 48 sector detail pages were visually inspected; direct detail sampling is five sectors and all20 zone selections.

shared_observed_findings: All20 desktop zone selected outlines are visibly complete inside their map crops, with legible numbered badges and native map imagery.
The desktop zone compass and bottom gesture hint do not obscure the selected outlines.
All20 final phone zone images are byte-identical to previously individually reviewed originals; the earlier bounded static-crop findings carry forward.

Five desktop sector maps display their named-sector qualification, native imagery and distinct purple footprints. Three are unobscured by the information card; two have the recorded nonblocking information-card occlusion.

Five desktop detail captures show readable semantic limitations, decoded original source-map photos, full-size links and map-focus controls. Related zone references remain qualified rather than silently copied as sector rosters.
No blank native-map load, missing selected outline, unreadable selected badge, broken source-photo rendering or horizontal text/button clipping was observed in the reviewed captures.

limits: This receipt is a bounded visual gate for exact candidate377fb91e03f2fea64237f0de031995b26090f468, not approval or proof of merge/deployment/live release.

Of132 artifact PNGs,30 desktop originals were directly visually reviewed and20 phone zone originals were checked for exact identity to a previous direct review. Remaining artifact images are outside this assigned review.
All20 Wild Zone selections were reviewed; only five representative desktop sector maps/details were reviewed. Do not claim visual review of all48 sector detail panels.
Map images are837×568 desktop element crops or343×478 phone element crops. The surrounding full-page layout and external controls are not established by these images.

Detail screenshots are element captures of varying heights; visible text/photos/buttons and initial roster content were inspected. They do not certify every further roster entry or content beyond the captured region.
Magenta Sector5 and Rouge Sector4 fixed information cards obscure short upper outline segments. This is explicitly accepted as nonblocking and must not be described as fully unobscured geometry.

Static screenshots do not independently establish clicking, scrolling, pinch, drag, rotation, north reset, keyboard interaction or live performance. The existing CI proof is referenced separately; no interactions/tests were rerun.

Rendered outlines are selection/sector-footprint representations. Thick strokes and native badges conceal some source pixels; this review does not repeat geometric calibration or establish physical walls, floor plans, routes, spawn positions or encounter availability.
WZ17 displayed connectivity is not proof of walkability. Source qualifications and approximate/unknown evidence remain applicable.
No guide screenshots are part of this area-artifact receipt; earlier six-guide findings require their own final-artifact identity evidence.
No original Workspace inspection, publication or parity verification was performed.
